description: Mapping NSI Building Data to HAZUS Building Inventory is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Omar A Sediek, University of Michigan (umich.edu). The aim of this project is to develop an algorithm that maps the building data from NSI data to be compatible with HAZUS building inventory. NSI data provides information about building material (i.e., concrete, steel, masonry, wood), number of stories, occupancy, and age. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: NSI Data, Building Inevntory, HAZUS. Published 2024-10-07. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
